# Journey Master Travels — Website Sample

Static HTML/CSS/JS website concept built for client presentation.

## Verified public business details used
- Name: Journey Master Travels
- Category: Travel agency, Tour operator
- Address: No-60/1 Boundary Road, Welihena Kochchikade, 11500, Sri Lanka
- Phone: +94 77 445 1011
- Current business listing showed 5.0 rating from 37 reviews and 24-hour opening daily when researched on 2026-09-21.

## Important before production launch
- Confirm the exact official address formatting with the owner.
- Confirm whether +94 77 445 1011 is also their WhatsApp number before adding a WhatsApp button.
- Confirm the agency's real service list, package names, prices, email, social accounts, registration/licensing details and booking terms.
- Replace example.com in robots.txt and sitemap.xml with the final domain.
- The tour cards are travel inspiration/sample presentation, not claims that the agency currently sells those exact packages.

## Images
The website intentionally does not use Journey Master Travels' own photos. It references free-use Pexels travel imagery in the page markup. For a production launch, download approved stock images locally and keep image credits/license records.

## Run
Open index.html directly, or upload the folder to GitHub Pages / Cloudflare Pages / any static hosting.
